# git-a2a

git-a2a applies Git component dependencies through saved platform adapter variants. Each
component declares one responsible A2A Agent Card reference and may publish a tracked surface.

- Site: https://git-a2a.com/
- Specification: https://github.com/neprel/git-a2a/blob/main/spec/README.md
- CLI: https://github.com/neprel/git-a2a/blob/main/docs/cli.md
- Schema 2: https://git-a2a.com/schema/
- Migration: https://github.com/neprel/git-a2a/blob/main/docs/migration-v2.md
- Demo: https://git-a2a.com/#demo
- Demo walkthrough: https://github.com/neprel/git-a2a-demo-acme-app#readme
- Demo transcript: https://github.com/neprel/git-a2a-demo-acme-app/blob/main/docs/demo-transcript.md
- Demo library: https://github.com/neprel/git-a2a-demo-acme-lib
